title: Build suppression from actual sends, never from enrollment
hypothesis: Everyone enrolled in a paused campaign had been emailed.
change: Rebuilt suppression from campaign activity, analytics and the send log instead of enrollment.
result: Treating enrollment as sent hid about 1,400 never-emailed contacts of the client's own list for a whole night.
next_decision: Suppress from sends plus everyone who must never be emailed again; gtm suppress --client NAME --csv gives email, last_sent and reason.
check: Every suppressed address carries a last-sent date from a send record or a never-again reason; enrolled but never sent isn't suppressed.
scope: Any client refilled from a list that earlier campaigns enrolled.
